data.narrative: The learner demonstrated exemplary engineering communication by authoring a rigorous, empathetic code review that caught a critical production division-by-zero bug while separating required changes from stylistic suggestions. They successfully deconstructed toxic review anti-patterns and rewrote hostile comments into actionable, collaborative guidance.

dimension_scores.observation: Distinguished blocking runtime crash from style preferences and provided copy-pasteable guards.
dimension_scores.evidence: Flagged ZeroDivisionError on total_age / cnt and provided guard `(total_age / cnt) if cnt > 0 else 0.0`.

dimension_scores.observation: Structured comments with clear problem statements, code locations, and unambiguous solutions.
dimension_scores.evidence: Used precise headings and code snippets in code-review.md and progress/communication/module-01-rewritten-review.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained psychological safety while upholding a high technical bar, praising purity and testability.
dimension_scores.evidence: Acknowledged lack of side effects and domain modeling before detailing necessary corrections.

dimension_scores.observation: Adopted summary review format with strict separation of bugs, suggestions, and final verdict.
dimension_scores.evidence: Adhered to all contract headings: Decision, Strengths, Required Changes, Suggestions, Final Verdict.

dimension_scores.observation: Formulated concrete next steps with zero ambiguous directives, making the review self-contained without needing sync meetings.
dimension_scores.evidence: Supplied drop-in helper function get_health_status and explicit variable renames.

strengths: Identified blocking ZeroDivisionError that careless reviews missed, connecting communication directly to production reliability.
Separated subjective code preferences from objective bugs using explicit severity labels.
data.recommendation: Continue applying this high standard of audience awareness and structured clarity when drafting architectural specifications and ADRs in Module 02.

public_evidence.student_action: Authored comprehensive code review identifying division-by-zero defect and refactoring nested conditionals.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Python user summary generation function review with ZeroDivisionError guard and helper extraction.
public_evidence.ability: Conducting constructive, bug-catching code reviews with high psychological safety and technical precision.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Protects production uptime while accelerating pull request velocity and junior engineer mentorship.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Provided concrete drop-in ternary guard and helper function in code-review.md.
Separated bugs from suggestions and phrased feedback constructively to avoid defensiveness.

teaching_approaches.detail: Side-by-side comparison of hostile vs. constructive review on identical Python code snippet.

learning_style_signals: Excels with structured checklists and comparative examples contrasting anti-patterns with best practices.
